part_functions.name: crossed-member support
part_functions.function: Provides two intersecting elongated structural members for supporting or positioning equipment around a central hub.

part_functions.name: central articulated connection
part_functions.function: The opposed rounded-square hub plates and coaxial cylindrical interfaces retain the crossed members while permitting assembly, indexing, or relative rotation about the central axis.

part_functions.name: remote attachment interfaces
part_functions.function: Axial cavities at the member ends provide interfaces for pins, fasteners, inserts, or attached extensions.

section_functions.name: diagonal load path
section_functions.function: Spans across the hub along the X-Z diagonal and transfers bending and axial loads between its two remote ends and the central joint.

section_functions.name: hub engagement
section_functions.function: Local widened and rounded transition geometry surrounds the central pivot region, distributing contact and bearing loads into the long member.

feature_functions.name: structural span
feature_functions.function: The long rounded beam acts as the primary diagonal spine; opposed segments are symmetric about the hub and resist bending with reduced edge stress.

feature_functions.name: axial end interface
feature_functions.function: The internal cylindrical passage and annular end faces accept coaxial pins, rods, or fasteners at the remote ends.

feature_functions.name: clearance and retention

section_functions.function: Forms the second long structural spine through the hub, approximately perpendicular to the diagonal member in the principal assembly plane.

section_functions.name: cross-member coordination
section_functions.function: Its locally relieved central region overlaps the diagonal member and shares the same hub axis without merging into the other member solid.

feature_functions.name: structural span
feature_functions.function: Transfers loads between the remote longitudinal ends and the hub through a symmetric, rounded beam profile.

feature_functions.name: axial attachment

section_functions.function: Large planar plate faces and rounded perimeter walls spread clamp and reaction loads while avoiding sharp external corners.
